mapper.select: select t.id as task_id, t.task_name as task_name, count(*) as totalCount, count(case when d.result = 'NORMAL' then 1 end) as normalCount, count(case when d.result = 'LOSS' then 1 end) as lossCount, count(case when d.result = 'GAIN' then 1 end) as gainCount, count(case when d.result = 'MISMATCH' then 1 end) as mismatchCount, count(case when d.result = 'LOSS' then 1 end) / count(*) as lossRate from inventory_detail d left join inventory_task t on d.task_id = t.id where d.task_id = #{taskId} group by d.task_id, t.task_name
